answer: An AI-agent economy can deter Sybils through remote enclave attestation, anchoring each peer to a hardware security island. Nodes use factory-fused keys as a cryptographic quill to sign identity proofs, forcing attackers to buy dedicated physical chips per persona instead of cloning software containers. Unverified nodes remain in an economic tundra with no transaction rights. However, this design depends on centralized chipmakers and remains vulnerable to side-channel exploits.
